title: Improvement of KLMS algorithm based on attention mechanism

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Improvement of KLMS algorithm based on attention mechanism》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】This paper proposes an attention-augmented kernel adaptive filtering framework that enhances the Kernel Least Mean Square (KLMS) algorithm by explicitly incorporating data-dependent attention mechanisms into its update structure.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Improvement of KLMS algorithm based on attention mechanism》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Extensive experiments conducted on both one-dimensional chaotic time series (Mackey-Glass and Lorenz) and two-dimensional millimeter-wave imaging datasets demonstrate that the proposed methods consistently outperform conventional KLMS variants in terms of prediction accuracy, convergence stability, and noise robustness.
